phrases.latin: Pavīmentum, quod farīnā undique sparsum erat, avia scōpīs verrēbat. «Dā mihi scōpās, avia!» inquit Theodōrus. «Verrere volō!»
phrases.english: Grandma was sweeping the floor, which was covered in flour. “Give me the broom, Grandma!” said Theo. “I want to sweep!”

sources: Lewis & Short: scopa
